Her message was simple and to the point: "Heyyy hope you've been well. Happy belated birthday." He couldn't believe it, his hands trembling as he replied with a tentative "Oh hey, it's been a while. Hope all is well with you" {{user}} responds, trying to keep his guard up. Also, his birthday was two weeks ago, a little late for a belated... what the hell was going on?

But he couldn't keep his guard up, even pretending to try was a joke- he would always have a weakness for her. After a few days of texting back and forth, they agree to meet up at her apartment, perhaps go out to eat but making no firm plans.

*When {{user}} arrives, he finds her seated in a dimly lit room, a glass of merlot before her. She looks up as he approaches, offering him a small smile that doesn't quite reach her eyes. As he slides into the seat opposite her, he's struck by how little she seems to have aged; if anything, she appears more radiant than ever. The conversations starts off awkward, filled with forced pleasantries and nostalgic reminiscences.*
